# Velo Capital Funding

> Velo Capital Funding (Velo) is a commercial financing brokerage, not a lender. It finds U.S. small businesses the best funding solution by working with a wide range of lenders and funders, and helps them get funded. Options include same-day funding, lines of credit, term loans, equipment financing, SBA loans, invoice factoring and home equity lines of credit. The lender or funder makes its own decision, sets its own terms and provides the funds. Business owners can apply online or book a call with a member of the team. All financing is for business purposes only and is subject to review and approval; timing varies and is not guaranteed.

Velo Capital Funding is a commercial financing broker, not a lender. Financing is provided by third-party lenders and funders, subject to their approval. Terms vary.

## Funding
- [Same-Day Business Funding](https://vcfus.com/funding/same-day-funding/): Fast working capital from a wide range of funders. Provided by third-party funders; Velo is a broker, not the funder.
- [Business Line of Credit](https://vcfus.com/funding/line-of-credit/): Draw what you need, when you need it. Offered by third-party lenders; Velo is not the lender.
- [Term Loans](https://vcfus.com/funding/term-loans/): A lump sum on a fixed schedule. Offered by third-party lenders; Velo is not the lender.
- [Equipment Financing](https://vcfus.com/funding/equipment-financing/): Financing secured by the equipment. Offered by third-party lenders; Velo is not the lender.
- [SBA Loans](https://vcfus.com/funding/sba-loans/): Long-term loans from SBA-participating lenders. Offered by third-party lenders; Velo is not the lender.
- [Invoice Factoring](https://vcfus.com/funding/invoice-factoring/): Sell unpaid B2B invoices to a factor for an advance on their value. Offered by third-party factoring companies; Velo is not the factor.
- [Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC)](https://vcfus.com/funding/home-equity-line-of-credit/): A revolving limit backed by your home equity. Secured by the owner's home; offered by licensed third-party lenders; Velo is not the lender.
- [Credit Card Processing](https://vcfus.com/funding/credit-card-processing/): Accept card payments with merchant processing services. A payments service, not a financing product.
- [Compare options](https://vcfus.com/compare/): How same-day funding compares with other common financing options.

## Getting started
- [How it works](https://vcfus.com/how-it-works/): The five steps from application to funding, and what you see in writing before you sign.
- [Funding planner](https://vcfus.com/calculator/): Add up what the funds need to cover to decide how much to request. Not an offer or estimate.
- [Apply](https://vcfus.com/apply/): The online application. Starting it does not involve a credit check.
- [Book a call](https://vcfus.com/book/): Schedule a 20-minute call with a member of the team.
- [Industries](https://vcfus.com/industries/): How funding works for restaurants, trucking, construction, medical and dental practices, retail and more.
- [FAQ](https://vcfus.com/faq/): Straight answers about how funding works, what it costs and what to expect.
- [Resources](https://vcfus.com/resources/): Plain-English guides to funding, cash flow and choosing the right option.
